name: hostim
description: Deploy and manage apps, databases, volumes and domains on Hostim, an EU cloud hosting platform.
long_description: The official Hostim MCP server, built into the `hostim` CLI. Deploy a Docker image or a Git repository, create managed Postgres, MySQL and Redis, add volumes and custom domains, and read app status, logs and events. Hostim runs on EU bare metal in Falkenstein, Germany. Read-only by default; tools that create, change or delete need write access turned on.

token.title: API token
token.description: Create one at console.hostim.dev under Account Settings → API Tokens.

allow_write.title: Allow changes
allow_write.description: Also expose tools that create, change and delete projects, apps, databases, volumes, env vars and domains.

tools.name: add_app_domain
tools.description: Attach a custom domain to an app. The domain then needs a DNS record pointing at the region ingress; check it with the CLI or the console.

tools.name: create_app
tools.description: Create an app in a project and start its first build. The app is built from a git repository the Hostim API clones, or from a published docker image. Poll get_app_status until the build finishes.

tools.name: create_database
tools.description: Create a MySQL, Postgres or Redis database in a project.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new project in a region. A project is the container every app, database and volume lives in.

tools.name: create_volume
tools.description: Create a storage volume in a project, to mount into an app.

tools.name: delete_app
tools.description: Delete an app. This cannot be undone.

tools.name: delete_database
tools.description: Delete a MySQL, Postgres or Redis database. The data is destroyed and cannot be recovered.

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description: Delete a project and everything in it. This cannot be undone.

tools.name: delete_volume
tools.description: Delete a storage volume. The data is destroyed and cannot be recovered.

tools.name: get_app
tools.description: Show one app's configuration: plan, replicas, port, domains, env vars, volumes and deployment source.

tools.name: get_app_events
tools.description: Read Kubernetes events for an app, most recent first. Use this to find out why an app is not starting.

tools.name: get_app_logs
tools.description: Read recent logs for an app: the stdout stream for runtime output, or the build stream to debug a failed build.

tools.name: get_app_status
tools.description: Show an app's build status, runtime status and internal DNS name. Poll this after creating or rebuilding an app.

tools.name: get_database_credentials
tools.description: Show the connection credentials for a database: host, port, user, password and database name.

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: List the apps in a project.

tools.name: list_databases
tools.description: List the MySQL, Postgres and Redis databases in a project.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List every Hostim project in the account, with its ID, region, deployed service count and projected monthly cost.

tools.name: list_region_plans
tools.description: List the valid plan names and prices in a region for apps, volumes, mysql, postgres and redis. Use a plan name from here when creating a resource.

tools.name: list_regions
tools.description: List the region names apps and databases can be deployed to.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List the curated deployment templates (app + databases + volumes) that can be applied to a project.

tools.name: list_volumes
tools.description: List the storage volumes in a project.

tools.name: rebuild_app
tools.description: Trigger a new build of an app from its deployment source. Poll get_app_status until it finishes.

tools.name: restart_app
tools.description: Restart a running app without rebuilding it.

tools.name: set_app_env
tools.description: Set or overwrite app environment variables. Variables not listed are kept. The app needs a rebuild or restart to pick them up.

tools.name: unset_app_env
tools.description: Remove app environment variables by name. The app needs a rebuild or restart to pick the change up.

tools.name: update_app
tools.description: Change an app's plan, replica count, HTTP port, visibility, health-check path or command override. Fields left out are unchanged; the deployment source cannot be changed here.
